content.comment_body: Hello, could someone show me how to enable the backlight when viewing or checking the display?
Is there a reason you are not communicating in English? Why do you continue to write in your native language?
Refer to [product_name] online help for assistance.

Hi [user_name], Please try to communicate in English, as this is an international forum and we prefer to keep discussions in a single language. Posting in English will increase your chances of getting help. Here is the translation of your question. Regards, [user_name]
I've contacted this user several times about this, but they continue to ignore the suggestion. They ask for help but do not want to use English themselves.
I write in English, but my computer automatically translates it into Italian and I can't disable the instant translation.

I try to write in English, but my computer keeps translating my text into Italian—I'm unable to remove this automatic translation. I have the same issue; when I write in German, it always shows up in Spanish.
Dear friends, let's see how well you handle criticism at age 70. I am doing my best, apologies! [IMAGE]

I am close to age 70 myself, and age may not be the issue here. If you claim to write in English and it automatically gets translated into Italian, that seems unusual. When I use Google to translate from German to English, I simply copy and paste the English version here without problems. I can also write directly in English if I know the words—minor mistakes are okay for everyone. If your PC has automatic translation enabled, please disable it. Best regards, [user_name]
Perhaps I have resolved the issue myself. [IMAGE]

analysis.insight_summary: The user asked for instructions on how to activate the display backlight, but the discussion shifted to difficulties with language and automatic translations. No direct guidance regarding the backlight was provided. The user later mentioned possibly solving the issue independently, without describing how.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wanted straightforward instructions or a demonstration on how to turn on the display backlight.
